name: GELBOYS
description: High schooler Fou4Mod falls for Chian at Siam Square. When he learns Chian's also with TikToker Bua, he uses his friend Babin to spark jealousy.

videos.title: GELBOYS Documentary
videos.overview: Get to know the series GELBOYS better through a documentary that tells the behind-the-scenes story before the series came to be.

videos.title: charging GEL [Side Story] EP. 1
videos.overview:
After Four Mod successfully exchanged phones with Faye Fang Kaew It's time to change the name of AirDrop!

But no matter how I think about it, I still haven't come up with a name that catches my eye. So I had to ask the crazy people to come and help think of one thing. ><

videos.title: charging GEL [Side Story] EP. 2
videos.overview: When the year ends, it's time for Spotify Wrapped to come visit🎶 Four Mod wondered if among the 5 songs that P'Chian listened to the most this year. Are there any songs that you listen to when you're together with him?🤔🤷‍♂️

videos.title: charging GEL [Side Story] EP. 3
videos.overview: Chian goes to an agreement with Bua that they will exchange gifts on Christmas Day. But Chian couldn't think of anything good to give, so he got Four Mod to help him think like that?!

videos.title: charging GEL [Side Story] EP. 4
videos.overview: After being reckless and not daring to confess his love to Four Mod, Baabin chose to quietly tell Fourmod on his secret Twitter account. However, one of his followers did not want the matter to end here.

videos.title: charging GEL [Side Story] EP. 5
videos.overview: Bua couldn't record a new TikTok clip because his phone was full. When she was about to delete the old clips she had recorded with Chian, he felt regretful. So, Bua decided to leave the clips with Baabin, but Baabin refused to accept them.

videos.title: charging GEL [Side Story] EP. 6
videos.overview: During the time that Chian was blocked by Four Mod on all social media channels, he tried not to interfere in Four Mod's life. He only posted pictures on his fake Instagram account when he missed him.

videos.title: charging GEL [Side Story] EP.7 part 1
videos.overview: After changing his status to having a boyfriend, Baabin had to deal with a new feeling that arose, which was jealousy. But it might have been a bit too much, to the point that he felt jealous of Bua even with the people who commented on Bua's Tiktok channel.

videos.title: charging GEL [Side Story] EP.7 part 2
videos.overview: Chian started wanting to show off his boyfriend on social media like everyone else. But this Green Flag guy's life was never easy when his boyfriend was the number 1 person in Siam Square when it came to taking pictures.

videos.title: GELBOYS Intro
videos.overview: Fou4mod eyes Baabin—but a senior with gel nails makes him rethink everything, including love.

videos.title: FOU4MOD
videos.overview: Chian makes a playlist with someone else—so Fou4mod plots payback, using Baabin’s hand.

videos.title: CHIAN
videos.overview: The story of Chian who has been held back by Bua and has not been his boyfriend for a year. It's time for Chian to choose whether to continue to suffer with Bua like this or to start over with Fou4mod, who just agreed that they will not have a status.

videos.title: BAABIN
videos.overview: Baabin slides into Fou4mod’s DMs—ready to risk their friendship for something more.

videos.title: BUA
videos.overview: Bua loses his TikTok partner—and realizes too late that Chian meant more than he thought.

videos.title: FOU4MOD BUA BAABIN CHIAN
videos.overview: The boys break ties, block each other, and fall apart—only to start again, separately.

videos.title: GELBOYS OUTRO
videos.overview: Chian and Baabin both fight for Fou4mod, but Bua gets caught in feelings he never planned.
